input.content:
# Payment Gateway — Multi-Host Deployment Guide

This guide is the operator manual for `deploy/deploy.ts`. It covers the 1-to-5
host topology, the environment reference, the certificate model, the firewall
policy and the recovery procedures.

> The platform is a 7-service monolith: `core-back` (the only service with a
> database credential and the `KMS_MASTER_KEY`), the three edge APIs
> (`admin-back`, `merchant-back`, `checkout-back`) and the three SPAs
> (`admin-front`, `merchant-front`, `checkout-front`).

## 1. Quick start

```bash
cp deploy/deploy.env.example deploy/deploy.env
chmod 600 deploy/deploy.env
$EDITOR deploy/deploy.env          # fill in hosts, domains, secrets

./deploy/deploy.sh --dry-run       # validate the config and print every action
./deploy/deploy.sh                 # first deploy (fresh bootstrap)
./deploy/deploy.sh --update        # subsequent deploys (no OS changes)
```

Flags:

| Flag | Meaning |
| :--- | :--- |
| `--env=<path>` | Use another `deploy.env` (default `deploy/deploy.env`). |
| `--only=core,checkout` | Deploy only those roles (comma separated). |
| `--fresh` | Bootstrap the OS (packages, ufw, bun, pm2) and enable the firewall. |
| `--update` | Never touch the OS or the firewall. |
| `--enforce-firewall` | Re-apply the UFW rules without a full bootstrap. |
| `--skip-build` | Reuse the existing `*/dist` builds. |
| `--skip-verify` | Skip the end-to-end mTLS health verification. |
| `--rotate-certs` | Regenerate the internal CA **and** every leaf certificate. |
| `--keep=<n>` | Releases kept per host (default `KEEP_RELEASES`). |
| `--dry-run` | Print every local and remote command, execute nothing. |

The script refuses to start if `deploy.env` is missing or invalid: every value
is validated with Zod before the first SSH connection.

## 2. The 1-to-5 host topology

The orchestrator groups the five logical roles by their SSH endpoint
(`SSH_HOST:SSH_PORT`). Roles that share an endpoint are one machine.

| Role | Runs | Public exposure |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `DB_HOST` | MySQL 8 / MariaDB 10.6+ (or PostgreSQL) | **Never** public. Accepts the DB port only from `CORE_PRIVATE_IP`. |
| `CORE_HOST` | `core-back` `:4000` (mTLS 1.3) | **Never** public. Accepts `:4000` only from the three edge private IPs. |
| `ADMIN_HOST` | `admin-back` `:4101` + `admin-front` via Nginx `:8443` | LAN only (`LAN_ALLOWED_CIDRS`). |
| `MERCHANT_HOST` | `merchant-back` `:4102` + `merchant-front` via Nginx `80/443` | Public HTTPS. |
| `CHECKOUT_HOST` | `checkout-back` `:4103` + `checkout-front` via Nginx `80/443` | Public HTTPS. |

Three supported shapes:

- **A — five servers:** every `*_SSH_HOST` is a distinct IP.
- **B — two servers:** e.g. `ADMIN_SSH_HOST = CORE_SSH_HOST` (internal) and
  `CHECKOUT_SSH_HOST = MERCHANT_SSH_HOST` (public edge). The script
  bootstraps each host once and merges both PM2 apps and both Nginx vhosts.
- **C — one staging box:** every `*_SSH_HOST` is the same IP. Ports stay
  distinct and mTLS is still enforced.

`./deploy/deploy.sh --dry-run` prints the resulting **Host Topology Map**,
which is the fastest way to confirm that your deduplication is what you meant.

## 3. Environment reference

### Global

| Variable | Default | Meaning |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `DEPLOY_MODE` | `auto` | `auto` (fresh when the remote dir is absent), `fresh`, `update`. |
| `KEEP_RELEASES` | `5` | Releases kept per host; older ones are pruned in step 11. |
| `ROTATE_MTLS_CERTS` | `false` | Force a CA + leaf regeneration. |
| `MTLS_VALIDITY_DAYS` | `825` | Leaf certificate validity. |
| `LAN_ALLOWED_CIDRS` | `10.0.0.0/8,192.168.0.0/16` | Nginx allowlist and `ADMIN_LAN_CIDRS` for the admin host. |

### Database (`DB_*`)

| Variable | Notes |
| :--- | :--- |
| `DB_MANAGE_VIA_SSH` | When `true`, the script creates the database and the application user on the DB host through its own sudo access. |
| `DB_SSH_HOST` / `_PORT` / `_USER` / `_KEY_PATH` / `_SUDO_PASSWORD` | SSH target of the database host. |
| `DB_PRIVATE_IP` | The address the core connects to. Must differ from `CORE_PRIVATE_IP`. |
| `DB_ENGINE` | `mysql` or `postgresql`. Must agree with `DATABASE_URL`. |
| `DB_PORT` | `3306` (MySQL/MariaDB) or `5432` (PostgreSQL). |
| `DB_NAME` / `DB_USER` | Identifier-safe database and role names. |
| `DB_PASSWORD` | The application role password (≥ 8 chars). |
| `DATABASE_URL` | The connection string the core uses. |

### Core (`CORE_*`)

`CORE_SSH_HOST`, `CORE_SSH_PORT`, `CORE_SSH_USER`, `CORE_SSH_KEY_PATH`,
`CORE_SUDO_PASSWORD`, `CORE_PRIVATE_IP` (bound and in the certificate SAN),
`CORE_PORT` (default 4000), `CORE_REMOTE_DIR` (default `/var/www/pg-core`),
`RUN_PRISMA_SEED` (`true` on the first deploy only).

### Admin (`ADMIN_*`)

`ADMIN_SSH_*`, `ADMIN_SUDO_PASSWORD`, `ADMIN_PRIVATE_IP`,
`ADMIN_BACK_PORT` (4101), `ADMIN_NGINX_LAN_PORT` (8443), `ADMIN_DOMAIN`,
`ADMIN_REMOTE_DIR`.

### Merchant (`MERCHANT_*`) and Checkout (`CHECKOUT_*`)

`*_SSH_*`, `*_SUDO_PASSWORD`, `*_PRIVATE_IP`, `*_BACK_PORT` (4102 / 4103),
`*_DOMAIN`, `*_SSL_MODE` (`certbot` | `custom` | `self_signed`),
`*_SSL_CERT_PATH` / `*_SSL_KEY_PATH` (required for `custom`),
`*_REMOTE_DIR`.

### Core-only secrets

| Variable | Notes |
| :--- | :--- |
| `KMS_MASTER_KEY` | Root key for the AES-256-GCM vault and the session signing. **Never** delivered to an edge host. |
| `BASE_CURRENCY` / `GATEWAY_TIMEZONE` | Defaults `LYD` / `Africa/Tripoli`. |
| `REDIS_URL` | Optional; enables cross-node `InvalidationBus`. |

## 4. Certificates (mTLS 1.3)

`deploy/lib/pkiManager.ts` creates the whole PKI in `deploy/.certs/`
(`chmod 600`, gitignored):

- `internal-ca.crt` / `internal-ca.key` — the offline root CA.
- `core-back.crt` / `.key` — the **server** certificate, SAN
  `IP:<CORE_PRIVATE_IP>, IP:127.0.0.1, DNS:core-back.internal`. The SAN is
  mandatory: the edge hosts reach the core by private IP and TLS 1.3 verifies
  the hostname.
- `admin-back-client`, `merchant-back-client`, `checkout-back-client` — the
  **client** certificates, `CN=admin-back|merchant-back|checkout-back`.

Least-privilege distribution:

| Host | Receives |
| :--- | :--- |
| `CORE_HOST` | `internal-ca.crt`, `core-back.crt`, `core-back.key` |
| `ADMIN_HOST` | `internal-ca.crt`, `admin-back-client.crt/.key` |
| `MERCHANT_HOST` | `internal-ca.crt`, `merchant-back-client.crt/.key` |
| `CHECKOUT_HOST` | `internal-ca.crt`, `checkout-back-client.crt/.key` |

`internal-ca.key` **never leaves the deployment workstation**. An edge host has
no database credential, no `KMS_MASTER_KEY` and no other host's client key, so
compromising one public host does not compromise the platform.

Rotate: `./deploy/deploy.sh --rotate-certs` (all hosts are updated in the same
run). Certificates are inspected in step 3 and again in the audit summary, with
the remaining validity in days.

## 5. Firewall policy (UFW)

| Host | Opened | Bound to |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `DB_HOST` | SSH, `DB_PORT` from `CORE_PRIVATE_IP` | — |
| `CORE_HOST` | SSH, `CORE_PORT` from the admin/merchant/checkout private IPs | — |
| `ADMIN_HOST` | SSH, `ADMIN_NGINX_LAN_PORT` from `LAN_ALLOWED_CIDRS` | `admin-back` on `127.0.0.1` |
| `MERCHANT_HOST` | SSH, 80, 443 | `merchant-back` on `127.0.0.1` |
| `CHECKOUT_HOST` | SSH, 80, 443 | `checkout-back` on `127.0.0.1` |

A host that runs several roles gets the union of its rules. The SSH rule is
always emitted, and `ufw --force enable` is the **last** command, so the deploy
can never lock itself out.

## 6. The 12-step pipeline

1. Validate `deploy.env` and print the topology map.
2. Build the three SPAs locally (`bun run build`).
3. Generate or verify the PKI.
4. Bootstrap each unique host (`--fresh`) and apply UFW.
5. Create the database and the application role; take a pre-migration backup
   (compressed) into `CORE_REMOTE_DIR/shared/backups/`.
6. Deploy `core-back`: rsync, certs, `.env`, `bun install --frozen-lockfile`,
   `prisma generate`, `migrate-deploy`, optional seed, atomic `current`
   symlink, PM2 reload.
7. Deploy `admin-back` + `admin-front` on the LAN vhost.
8. Deploy `merchant-back` + `merchant-front` (unbuffered POS SSE).
9. Deploy `checkout-back` + `checkout-front` (unbuffered payer SSE, strict CSP).
10. Verify: the core `/health` over mTLS, each edge backend `/health`, each edge
    host completing an mTLS handshake to **its own** core channel, and the
    public vhosts.
11. Prune old releases.
12. Print the audit summary (commit, release timestamp, hosts, certificate
    expiry).

Release layout on every host:

```
<REMOTE_DIR>/
├── releases/<TIMESTAMP>/
│   ├── <back>/            # the backend source (+ .env symlink)
│   └── <front>/dist/      # the built SPA (edge hosts only)
├── shared/
│   ├── .env               # 0600, symlinked into every release
│   ├── certs/             # only the host's allowed certificate material
│   ├── pm2/<app>.config.cjs
│   └── backups/
└── current -> releases/<TIMESTAMP>
```

## 7. Verification and recovery

If step 10 fails the deploy exits non-zero; the previous release is still on
disk. Roll back one host:

```bash
ssh <host>
ls -1dt /var/www/pg-<role>/releases/*/
ln -sfn /var/www/pg-<role>/releases/<previous> /var/www/pg-<role>/current
pm2 restart pg-<role>-back
```

Roll back every host by re-running `./deploy/deploy.sh --only=...` from a
checkout at the previous commit (the releases are immutable).

Common failures:

| Symptom | Cause / fix |
| :--- | :--- |
| `SSH key '…' does not exist` | Fix `*_SSH_KEY_PATH`; the key must exist on the workstation. |
| `Invalid deploy.env: DATABASE_URL must start with mysql://` | `DATABASE_URL` and `DB_ENGINE` disagree. |
| `DB_PRIVATE_IP and CORE_PRIVATE_IP cannot be the same host` | The design keeps the database on its own node; use a separate IP or set `DB_MANAGE_VIA_SSH=false` and point `DATABASE_URL` at an external database. |
| `missing certificate /etc/letsencrypt/…` | Issue it: `certbot --nginx -d <domain> --agree-tos -m ops@<domain>`. |
| `core /health (mTLS) FAIL` | The core did not start: `pm2 logs pg-core-back`, then check `shared/.env`. |
| `mTLS -> core /internal/admin/health FAIL` | The client certificate does not match the channel (`CN=admin-back` is required on `/internal/admin`). |
| The whole deploy aborts after step 10 | No host was left broken; the previous release is still on disk. |

## 8. Security notes

- `deploy.env` and `deploy/.certs/` are gitignored; keep `deploy.env` at `0600`.
- A secret is written over SSH stdin (`cat > file`), never via a local temp
  file and never on a command line.
- The core listens on `0.0.0.0` **inside the private network only**; UFW is the
  outer ring and the mTLS CN guard is the inner one.
- `TRUST_PROXY=false` on the core: the edge resolves the client IP and forwards
  it in `x-real-client-ip`, and the core treats it as advisory (the per-token
  CIDR check still applies).
- The edge `.env` files contain no `DATABASE_URL`, no `KMS_MASTER_KEY` and no
  other host's certificate.

section = '''## 16. Multi-Host Deployment Engine (`deploy/`)

Implemented from `design/payment_gateway_deployment_and_guides_architecture.md` Part I (PG-D1…PG-D4).

### 16.1 What it does

| Piece | File | Behaviour |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Config + validation | `deploy/lib/configSchema.ts` | Parses `deploy.env` and validates every value with Zod 4 **before the first SSH connection**: IPs, CIDRs, FQDN domains, ports, identifier-safe DB names, `DATABASE_URL` ⟷ `DB_ENGINE` agreement, custom-SSL certificate paths, distinct merchant/checkout domains, distinct ports, and the database host never sharing an IP with the core. |
| Host planner | `deploy/lib/hostPlanner.ts` | Deduplicates the 5 logical roles by `SSH_HOST:SSH_PORT` into 1…5 concrete hosts. Merges PM2 services, Nginx vhosts, certificate bundles and **unions the UFW rules**; rejects two roles on one host that use different SSH keys/users. Classifies the topology (`single-host` / `split` / `distributed`) and renders the Host Topology Map. |
| PKI | `deploy/lib/pkiManager.ts` | Generates an offline internal CA (10y) and four leaf certificates: the core **server** certificate with `IP:<CORE_PRIVATE_IP>, IP:127.0.0.1, DNS:core-back.internal` in its SAN, and `CN=admin-back` / `CN=merchant-back` / `CN=checkout-back` client certificates. Idempotent, rotates on `--rotate-certs`, and inspects validity + SANs for the audit summary. `certFilesForHost` implements the least-privilege distribution (the CA **key** never leaves the workstation; an edge host only receives its own client certificate). |
| SSH runner | `deploy/lib/sshRunner.ts` | `ssh` with `BatchMode`/`StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new`, privileged commands through `sudo -S` with the password on **stdin**, `rsync` for the release trees, and `writeRemoteFile` that streams a secret over ssh stdin so it never touches the local disk. |
| Firewall | `deploy/lib/firewallConfigurator.ts` | Base deny + role rules derived from the plan: the database only from the core IP, the core only from the three edge IPs, the admin portal only from `LAN_ALLOWED_CIDRS`, the public edge only SSH/80/443. The SSH rule is always present and `ufw --force enable` runs last, so a deploy can never lock itself out. |
| Verification | `deploy/lib/healthVerifier.ts` | Runs ON each host with that host's own certificate: the core `/health` over mTLS, each edge backend `/health`, each edge completing a mutual TLS handshake to **its own** core channel, and the public vhosts. |
| Orchestrator | `deploy/deploy.ts` + `deploy/deploy.sh` | The ordered 12 steps (validate → build SPAs → PKI → bootstrap+UFW → DB provisioning + pre-migration backup → core → admin → merchant → checkout → verify → prune → audit). Atomic `releases/<ts>/` + `current` symlink, `shared/.env` (0600, symlinked into each release), PM2 ecosystem per service, Nginx render + `nginx -t` + reload. Flags: `--env`, `--only`, `--fresh`, `--update`, `--enforce-firewall`, `--skip-build`, `--skip-verify`, `--rotate-certs`, `--keep`, `--dry-run`. |
| Templates | `deploy/templates/*.tpl` | Multi-app PM2 (`core`/`edge`), LAN-only admin vhost (`allow <LAN_CIDR>; deny all;`, TLS 1.3, HSTS/CSP), public merchant vhost (80→443 + unbuffered POS SSE) and public checkout vhost (80→443 + unbuffered payer SSE + strict CSP). |
| Operator manual | `deploy/DEPLOYMENT_GUIDE.md` | Quick start, the 1-to-5 host topology, the full environment dictionary, the certificate model, the firewall matrix, the 12 steps, the release layout, rollback and a troubleshooting table. |

### 16.2 Verification

- `deploy`: typecheck clean, **25 tests** (config validation incl. every rejection case, the 5/2/1-host scenarios, firewall union + restriction, the edge `.env` never containing `DATABASE_URL`/`KMS_MASTER_KEY`, the topology map, CLI parsing, env quoting and absolute cert paths, the PM2 ecosystem, and all three Nginx templates rendering with **no placeholder left**).
- `./deploy/deploy.sh --dry-run` walks the full 12-step pipeline against a sample `deploy.env` and prints every ssh/rsync/file action without executing anything.

## 17. The Four Built-In Portal Guides & Employee Academy

Implemented from the same design's Part II (PG-G1…PG-G5).

### 17.1 Backend (PG-G1)

| Change | Detail |
| :--- | :--- |
| Schema | `users.academy_progress_json` and `rails.help_guide_json` (migration `20261028100000_add_guides_support`, `schema_versions = 6`, applied to the live database). |
| Seed | `prisma/seedGuides.ts`: the `checkout.support_config` platform setting (channels, working hours, 3 bilingual FAQs) and **13 bilingual per-rail help guides** (steps, prerequisites, troubleshooting) for Edfali, Sadad, Moamalat Card, CBL LYPay, LYPay, MyPay, T-LYNC, MobiCash, OnePay, Yussor, Sahara, MPGS, Evo Pay and NeomPay. |
| Admin API | `GET/PUT /internal/admin/settings/checkout-support` (versioned + audited) and `GET/PUT /internal/admin/academy/progress` + `GET /internal/admin/academy/progress/overview`. Edge routes: `/api/v1/admin/settings/checkout-support`, `/api/v1/admin/academy/progress[/overview]`. |
| Checkout API | `GET /internal/checkout/pay/:linkKey` now returns `supportConfig` (only when `enabled`, honouring `show_platform_contact` / `show_merchant_contact`, the merchant's public contact, the FAQ) and a `helpGuide` on every visible rail. The projection is a whitelist: a field the admin stores but the contract does not expose can never leak to the payer. |

### 17.2 The four systems (PG-G2…PG-G5)

| # | Portal | What was built |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 1 | `admin-front` `/guide` | Searchable 10-book guide + glossary (error codes, GL accounts, statuses), ranked filter with match highlighting, `Ctrl/Cmd+K` command palette, right-side slide-over chapter drawer, and three simulators: a chained **Transform Sandbox**, a **Crypto Signature Lab** that shows the exact canonical string for all four modes, and a **Ledger T-Account Explorer** over the 15 business events with a balanced/unbalanced badge (all money math in `decimal.js`, no `eval`). |
| 2 | `admin-front` `/academy` | 8 A-to-Z modules with lessons, sandbox labs and quizzes, progress persisted through `GET/PUT /api/v1/admin/academy/progress`, a progress bar and the four role badges (`CERTIFIED_OPERATOR`, `CERTIFIED_COMPLIANCE`, `CERTIFIED_FINANCE`, `CERTIFIED_GATEWAY_ARCHITECT`), resilient to an API outage. |
| 3 | `merchant-front` `/guide` | 9 bilingual chapters with a role filter (owner / staff / cashier / developer), a persisted "first 5 steps" onboarding checklist, an interactive **fee & net-settlement calculator** implementing the three fee bearers in `decimal.js`, and a **developer API/webhook sandbox** generating cURL, TypeScript, PHP and Python snippets with copy buttons. |
| 4 | `checkout-front` + `admin-front` | `PerRailInstructionsBanner` (the selected rail's numbered steps + prerequisites) and `CheckoutHelpDrawer` (state-aware guidance for VERIFYING/UNKNOWN/FAILED/EXPIRED/CANCELLED, a 1-click "copy payment reference", the platform FAQ, and the admin-configured WhatsApp / call / email / merchant contact / working-hours block that disappears entirely when `checkout.support_config.enabled` is false), plus the operator page `/settings/checkout-help` with a live payer preview. |

| Frontends | `admin-front` (guide + academy + settings page), `merchant-front` (guide) and `checkout-front` (help drawer + banner) all build |

Done. I implemented both parts of the design — the multi-host deployment engine and the four portal guides — with tests and a live-database verification.

## Part I — Multi-Host Deployment Engine (`deploy/`, new)

Nine files, ~2,400 lines, **25 tests**, reachable through `./deploy/deploy.sh`:

- **`lib/configSchema.ts`** — Zod 4 validation of `deploy.env` *before the first SSH connection*: IPs, CIDRs, domains, ports, `DATABASE_URL` ⟷ `DB_ENGINE` agreement, custom-SSL paths, distinct domains/ports, and the database refusing to share an IP with the core.
- **`lib/hostPlanner.ts`** — deduplicates the 5 roles by `SSH_HOST:SSH_PORT` into **1, 2 or 5 hosts**, merging PM2 apps, Nginx vhosts, cert bundles and unioning UFW rules; rejects two roles on one host with different keys. Tested against all three scenarios (5-server, 2-host split, all-in-one) plus the firewall restrictions.
- **`lib/pkiManager.ts`** — offline internal CA + leaf certs, the core server cert carrying `IP:<CORE_PRIVATE_IP>` in its SAN, and `CN=admin-back|merchant-back|checkout-back` clients. `certFilesForHost` enforces least privilege: the CA *key* never leaves the workstation, an edge host gets only its own client cert.
- **`lib/sshRunner.ts`** — `sudo -S` with the password on stdin, rsync releases, and `writeRemoteFile` streaming secrets over ssh stdin (never to local disk).
- **`lib/firewallConfigurator.ts`** — the design's UFW matrix; SSH rule always present, `ufw --force enable` last so the deploy can't lock itself out.
- **`lib/healthVerifier.ts`** — runs *on each host* with *its own* certificate: core `/health` over mTLS, each edge backend, each edge → its own core channel, and the public vhosts.
- **`deploy.ts` / `deploy.sh`** — the ordered 12 steps with atomic `releases/<ts>/` + `current`, `shared/.env` (0600), per-service PM2 ecosystem, Nginx render + `nginx -t` + reload, pre-migration backup, prune, audit summary. Flags include `--only`, `--fresh`, `--update`, `--enforce-firewall`, `--rotate-certs`, `--dry-run`.
- **5 templates** (multi-app PM2, LAN-only admin, public merchant with unbuffered POS SSE, public checkout with unbuffered payer SSE) and **`DEPLOYMENT_GUIDE.md`** (env dictionary, cert model, firewall matrix, rollback, troubleshooting).

`--dry-run` walks the whole pipeline and prints every action — verified end-to-end.

## Part II — The Four Portal Guides

**Backend (PG-G1):** two new columns (`users.academy_progress_json`, `rails.help_guide_json`) with migration `20261028100000` (`schema_versions = 6`, applied live); `seedGuides.ts` seeds the `checkout.support_config` setting and **13 bilingual per-rail walkthroughs** (steps, prerequisites, troubleshooting); endpoints `GET/PUT /settings/checkout-support` (versioned + audited) and `GET/PUT /academy/progress` (+ overview), mirrored on the admin edge; and `GET /pay/:linkKey` now returns `supportConfig` plus a `helpGuide` on every visible rail, through a **whitelist projection** (a stored field the contract doesn't expose can't leak to the payer).

**Frontends (PG-G2…G5), all building:**
1. `admin-front /guide` — 10-book searchable guide + glossary, `Ctrl/Cmd+K`, slide-over drawer, and three simulators (chained transforms, crypto canonical-string lab, 15-event T-account explorer) in `decimal.js`.
2. `admin-front /academy` — 8 A-to-Z modules, labs, quizzes, persisted progress and four role badges.
3. `merchant-front /guide` — role-filtered chapters, persisted onboarding checklist, fee/net-settlement calculator, and a cURL/TS/PHP/Python API sandbox.
4. `checkout-front` help drawer + per-rail banner (state-aware guidance, one-click reference copy, admin-configured WhatsApp/phone/email that hides instantly when disabled) and the admin `/settings/checkout-help` page with a live preview.

I also ticked all 9 `PG-*` checklist items in the source design and documented both parts in §16 and §17 of the delivery tracker. One scoping note: the design names PostgreSQL *or* MySQL and I made **MySQL/MariaDB the default** (matching the platform), while the engine still supports `DB_ENGINE="postgresql"`.
